apple.name: Good Eye: Split the Shape
apple.subtitle: Shape splitting puzzle
apple.description: Choose a line to split an original shape, then see how close the two areas are to equal. Adjust its position and angle before the cut. Practice offers a short direction cue; Daily Five gives five UTC-based rounds and preserves first-attempt scores. Seeded practice and progress save on this device.
